integrity_statement: The theorem is a self-reviewed deduction from explicitly cited prior lemmas and classical sieve estimates. No independent audit or external certification has been performed; no numerical experiment is presented as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Quantitative lower bound only, not an asymptotic for all discrepancy-rich integers; the construction is non-effective and not uniform when discrepancy or number of templates grows with the cutoff; cited source lemmas and classical analytic results are essential; independent mathematical validation remains outstanding.
title: Unbounded multiplicity at the prime-prefix scale for distinct-prime partition discrepancies
